newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Prudential arm, Trammell in warehouse project.
newsitem.headline: Prudential arm, Trammell in warehouse project.

text.p: Trammell Crow International China (TCIC) and a subsidiary of insurance giant The Prudential Insurance Co of America said on Thursday they had formed a joint venture to develop warehouses and distribution centres in China.

The new company, China Distri-Park Ltd, would have authorised capital of US$200 million and would develop modern warehouses throughout China, Prudential Asset Management Group (PAMG) and Trammell said in a statement.
China Distri-Park would manage the real estate and lease space to multinationals, and to international distribution and logistics specialists, they said.
They said China Distri-Park planned to develop between 15 and 20 warehouse distribution centres in cities like Guangzhou, Shanghai, Beijing, Wuhan and Chengdu.
They said TCIC had assembled a team to identify sites, manage constructions and work with customers three years ago.
The first centre, a 20,000 square-metre Shekou Logistics Centre in Shekou in Shenzhen Special Economic Zone was scheduled to be completed before the end of 1997, they said.
Trammell Crow International China is an affiliate of the Trammell Crow Group of Companies, a privately-owned U.S. real estate developer.
